fix(camellia): use select for capability type

Summary:
- change the capability type form field from free text to a fixed select
- localize capability type labels for the list column and dropdown options

Rationale:
- capability type should only allow the supported HOME and TEMPLATE_FILTER values
- reusing the existing mark translation pattern keeps capability aligned with
  other camellia CRUD pages

Tests:
- cd theaceae && pnpm run typecheck:camellia
- cd theaceae && pnpm --filter @theaceae/camellia build
